entries.proposition: REAGENT IDENTITY: affinity-purified polyclonal raised against WWOX residues 12-94, spanning both WW domains. DATO. entries.proposition: FIGURE 2 RIGHT BLOT, NATIVE PIXELS - TWO LANES DO NOT MATCH THE TEXT. Lane labels were mapped to raster columns from the PDF word coordinates and confirmed on the 400-dpi render. SNU423 carries a strong 2.2-kb WWOX band (mean darkness 147 on 0-255 in the band row, against 156 for the Normal lane of the same blot) - not 'significantly underexpressed'. SNU475 shows no visible band (18, the same as HLE at 15 and HLF at 8, both called undetectable) - it belongs with the undetectable group, not the underexpressed one. SNU387 is faint (33), consistent with the text. CAVEATS: strong bands are saturated, so darkness is a ceiling not a quantity; the Normal lane's beta-actin is much weaker (56) than every cell-line lane (130-212), so per-actin the normal liver signal is higher than the raw band suggests. INFERENZA from pixels and a crude column measurement, not the authors' quantification.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 4, NATIVE PIXELS - 17 LINES, NOT 18, AND WHAT '13' COUNTS. Figure 4A has 19 lanes: Normal 1, Normal 2 and 17 HCC lines; Chang is absent from both blots and from the 17 bars of Figure 4B. All 17 bars lie below 0.50 (HepG2 highest, about 0.46), confirming the >50% sentence. Exactly 13 bars lie below 0.10 (Hep40, SK-Hep-1, Focus, Huh-6, HLF, HLE, Huh-7, Hep3B, 7703, SNU182 about 0.095, SNU387, SNU423, SNU475), so the sentence means 'more than 90% lower than normal', and its denominator should be 17 (13/17 = 76%), not 18. The Discussion's '75%' fits 13/17, not 13/18. INFERENZA from pixel counts.
